Climate change is a long-term shift in global weather patterns. It is caused primarily by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels. These activities release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. The gases trap heat from the sun and warm the planet. This warming affects weather systems around the world. Scientists agree that immediate steps must be taken to reduce emissions. Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind can help. Energy efficiency in buildings and transportation can also help. International cooperation is needed to address this challenge effectively.
